sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代在夜店当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带着30万件最珍贵的藏品去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个充满美丽、有50年历史的艺术品的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today, President Trump arrives in Israel with a message from the Muslim world.
sentences.zh: 今天，特朗普总统带着来自穆斯林世界的讯息抵达以色列。

sentences.en: If Israel wants peace with its Arab neighbors, they'll have to compromise with the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 如果以色列想要与阿拉伯邻国实现和平，他们就必须对巴勒斯坦人做出妥协。

sentences.en: And Michael Flynn has been out of the White House for three months, but his saga continues.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·弗林离开白宫已经三个月了，但他的传奇仍在继续。

sentences.en: Plus, the Islamic State is claiming credit for a deadly explosion at a concert in Manchester, England.
sentences.zh: 此外，伊斯兰国宣称对英国曼彻斯特一场演唱会发生的致命爆炸事件负责。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, May 23rd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月23日，星期二。

sentences.en: Shalom.
sentences.zh: 沙洛姆。

sentences.en: I'm trying to reach a guest named Peter Baker.
sentences.zh: 我想找一位名叫彼得·贝克的嘉宾。

sentences.en: B-A-K-E-R.
sentences.zh: B-A-K-E-R.

sentences.en: What is the last name?
sentences.zh: 姓什么？

sentences.en: Baker.
sentences.zh: 贝克。

sentences.en: B-A-K-E-R.
sentences.zh: B-A-K-E-R.

sentences.en: Baker.
sentences.zh: 贝克。

sentences.en: Like bakery.
sentences.zh: 就像面包店那样。

sentences.en: Like bakery.
sentences.zh: 就像面包店那样。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 喂。

sentences.en: Peter.
sentences.zh: 彼得。

sentences.en: Hello there.
sentences.zh: 你好啊。

sentences.en: Peter.
sentences.zh: 彼得。

sentences.en: Peter, yesterday it was Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 彼得，昨天还在沙特阿拉伯。

sentences.en: Where am I reaching you now?
sentences.zh: 我是在哪里联系到你的？

sentences.en: If it's Monday, it must be Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 如果今天是星期一，那一定是在耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: So here we are.
sentences.zh: 所以我们到了。

sentences.en: We're in the Holy City, and President Trump is here to make peace between the Israelis and the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 我们在圣城，特朗普总统来到这里是为了促成以色列人和巴勒斯坦人之间的和平。

sentences.en: And it feels like, right away.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉像是，马上就要发生了。

sentences.en: Ladies and gentlemen, the Honorable Donald J.
sentences.zh: 女士们先生们，尊敬的唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump, President of the United States of America.
sentences.zh: 特朗普，美利坚合众国总统。

sentences.en: The President made some pretty significant news in Israel.
sentences.zh: 总统在以色列发表了一些相当重大的新闻。

sentences.en: What happened?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, he did.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实发生了。

sentences.en: Look, he took on this very, very vexing problem from the very start.
sentences.zh: 你看，他从一开始就着手处理这个非常非常棘手的问题。

sentences.en: Literally, the minute he gets off the plane.
sentences.zh: 字面意思上，他一走下飞机就开始了。

sentences.en: Thank you, and shalom.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，沙洛姆。

sentences.en: He gives a short speech at the airport.
sentences.zh: 他在机场发表了简短的演讲。

sentences.en: Mr. President, I appreciate the opportunity to learn about your thoughts and vision.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，我很感激有机会了解您的想法和愿景。

sentences.en: Then he goes and meets with Israel's president.
sentences.zh: 然后他去会见了以色列总统。

sentences.en: Most importantly, the United States and Israel can declare with one voice that Iran must never be allowed to possess a nuclear weapon.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，美国和以色列可以发出同一个声音宣布，绝不能允许伊朗拥有核武器。

sentences.en: Never, ever.
sentences.zh: 绝对不能。

sentences.en: And then gives a longer talk, which he basically says, if you want to reorder the Middle East, as you have talked about,
sentences.zh: 然后他发表了更长的讲话，他基本上说，如果你想重组中东，正如你所说的那样，

sentences.en: that is to align yourself with the Sunni Arab states against your mutual enemy of Iran.
sentences.zh: 也就是让自己与逊尼派阿拉伯国家结盟，来对抗你们共同的敌人伊朗。

sentences.en: There is a growing realization among your Arab neighbors that they have common cause with you and the threat posed by Iran, and it is indeed a threat.
sentences.zh: 你的阿拉伯邻国越来越意识到，他们和你有着共同的目标，那就是伊朗带来的威胁，这确实是一个威胁。

sentences.en: There's no question about that.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问。

sentences.en: There's a price to pay, and that price is you have to make peace with the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 这是有代价的，而这个代价就是你必须与巴勒斯坦人实现和平。

sentences.en: That's what the Arabs are telling me, and that's what I'm telling you.
sentences.zh: 这就是阿拉伯人对我说的话，这也是我对你们说的话。

sentences.en: On those issues, there is a strong consensus among the nations of the world, including many in the Muslim world.
sentences.zh: 在这些问题上，世界各国之间有着强烈的共识，包括穆斯林世界的许多国家。

sentences.en: I was deeply encouraged by my conversations with Muslim world leaders in Saudi Arabia.
sentences.zh: 我在沙特阿拉伯与穆斯林世界领导人的对话深受鼓舞。

sentences.en: He just came from Riyadh, where he met not only with King Salman of Saudi Arabia, but with literally dozens of leaders from the Muslim world.
sentences.zh: 他刚从利雅得过来，在那里他不仅会见了沙特阿拉伯国王萨尔曼，还与穆斯林世界的数十位领导人进行了会晤。

sentences.en: And what they, you know, they bent his ear, obviously.
sentences.zh: 他们，你知道的，显然向他倾诉了很多。

sentences.en: They gave him their point of view of the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 他们向他阐述了他们对中东的看法。

sentences.en: They gave him their point of view of Israel.
sentences.zh: 他们向他阐述了他们对以色列的看法。

sentences.en: And he's obviously communicating that now to Prime Minister Netanyahu.
sentences.zh: 显然他现在正在把这些传达给内塔尼亚胡总理。

sentences.en: So he's telling the prime minister here that there's room.
sentences.zh: 所以他在这里告诉总理，这里有空间。

sentences.en: In fact, the Arab world is ready to accept Israel because they have this mutual enemy, Iran.
sentences.zh: 事实上，阿拉伯世界已经准备好接受以色列，因为他们有这个共同的敌人——伊朗。

sentences.en: But there has to be progress on the thing that will be difficult for them to accept, which is the continued occupation of the West Bank and the Palestinian people there.
sentences.zh: 但对于他们难以接受的事情，必须取得进展，那就是对约旦河西岸及当地巴勒斯坦人的持续占领。

sentences.en: So do we think, Peter, that the president genuinely changed his perspective on what it's going to take to put together any kind of Arab-Israeli peace deal?
sentences.zh: 那么彼得，我们认为总统真的改变了他对促成任何阿拉伯-以色列和平协议所需条件的看法吗？

sentences.en: Or was this all part of the plan from the start to come from Saudi Arabia to Israel with this message?
sentences.zh: 还是说这从一开始就是计划的一部分，带着这个信息从沙特阿拉伯来到以色列？

sentences.en: Well, he clearly is learning.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他显然在学习。

sentences.en: I mean, this is all new to him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这一切对他是崭新的。

sentences.en: I mean, you know, he's never been a politician before, much less a president.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你知道的，他以前从来不是政治家，更不用说总统了。

sentences.en: Understanding the intricacies of Middle East peacemaking, you know, requires time on the ground, requires exposure to the people who live it every day.
sentences.zh: 理解中东和平进程的错综复杂，你知道的，需要实地考察，需要接触那些每天生活在其中的人。

sentences.en: And over the four months that he's been president, he's had a number of these leaders to the White House to meet.
sentences.zh: 在他担任总统的四个月里，他接待了许多这样的领导人到白宫会面。

sentences.en: And he has learned over that period what their needs are, what their requirements are.
sentences.zh: 在这段期间，他了解了他们的需求是什么，他们的要求是什么。

sentences.en: And he is a dealmaker.
sentences.zh: 他是一个交易促成者。

sentences.en: He clearly is taking that on board and trying to figure out, okay, this is what these guys need, what these guys need, and how can we make them reconcile?
sentences.zh: 他显然正在吸收这些意见，并试图弄清楚，好吧，这些家伙需要这个，那些家伙需要那个，我们如何让他们和解？

sentences.en: Now, that doesn't mean he's going to be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 现在，这并不意味着他一定能做到。

sentences.en: But, you know, he's making an effort, and that's, you know, a different situation right now in this region.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道的，他在做出努力，这你知道的，目前这个地区的情况有所不同。

sentences.en: So what he is doing is called the outside-in approach.
sentences.zh: 所以他正在做的事情被称为“由外向内”的方法。

sentences.en: It's not new, but it means that instead of trying to create a deal between the Israelis and Palestinians
sentences.zh: 这并不新鲜，但这意味着不是试图在以色列人和巴勒斯坦人之间达成协议，

sentences.en: and then use that to create peace between the Israelis and their Arab neighbors, go the other direction,
sentences.zh: 然后利用这一点在以色列与其阿拉伯邻国之间实现和平，而是反其道而行之，

sentences.en: try to get the Arab neighbors on board with the idea of recognizing Israel, creating a new relationship with them.
sentences.zh: 试图让阿拉伯邻国赞同承认以色列、与以色列建立新关系的想法。

sentences.en: And that would then put pressure on the Palestinians to come to the table and create an actual deal.
sentences.zh: 这将给巴勒斯坦人施加压力，让他们坐到谈判桌前并达成实际协议。

sentences.en: So the way his thinking has changed is that you cannot just pressure the Israelis and the Palestinians to make peace with one another.
sentences.zh: 所以他思想上的转变在于，你不能只向以色列人和巴勒斯坦人施压让他们彼此媾和。

sentences.en: You have to involve their Arab neighbors to also put pressure on the Palestinians and maybe on Israel, too.
sentences.zh: 你必须让他们的阿拉伯邻国也参与进来，对巴勒斯坦人施加压力，也许对以色列也是如此。

sentences.en: On both, on both, because Israel has something to gain here as well as the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 双方都要，双方都要，因为以色列和巴勒斯坦一样，在这里有所收获。

sentences.en: Israel wants to be friends, or at least, you know, not enemies, with the Saudis and the Emiratis and the Qataris
sentences.zh: 以色列想要成为朋友，或者至少，你知道的，不是敌人，与沙特、阿联酋、卡塔尔

sentences.en: and the other Arab states around here, with which it does not have diplomatic relations.
sentences.zh: 以及这里其他没有外交关系的阿拉伯国家。

sentences.en: You know, one of the interesting things that happened today was Air Force One flew from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, to Tel Aviv, Israel.
sentences.zh: 你知道，今天发生的一件有趣的事是，空军一号从沙特阿拉伯利雅得飞往了以色列特拉维夫。

sentences.en: That never happened before.
sentences.zh: 这以前从未发生过。

sentences.en: No plane has ever, at least publicly, flown directly from Saudi Arabia to Israel.
sentences.zh: 从来没有飞机，至少在公开场合，直接从沙特阿拉伯飞往以色列。

sentences.en: But the Palestinians also depend on these Arab neighbors as well.
sentences.zh: 但巴勒斯坦人也同样依赖这些阿拉伯邻国。

sentences.en: They have something to gain here, which is that they provide them with support of a financial nature and a political and cultural nature.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里也有所收获，那就是阿拉伯人会给予他们财政、政治和文化方面的支持。

sentences.en: The Palestinians couldn't survive without the Arab support that they get.
sentences.zh: 如果没有阿拉伯人的支持，巴勒斯坦人将无法生存。

sentences.en: And the Arabs are tired of this problem.
sentences.zh: 而阿拉伯人已经厌倦了这个问题。

sentences.en: They want it to be solved and to go away.
sentences.zh: 他们希望这个问题得到解决并消失。

sentences.en: They don't get excited about the Palestinian cause anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们对巴勒斯坦事业不再感到兴奋。

sentences.en: They just want everybody to sit down, come over the deal so they can move on, because they're focused on Iran, which they see as the real hegemonic aspirant in this neighborhood
sentences.zh: 他们只想让所有人都坐下来，达成协议以便继续前进，因为他们的焦点在伊朗，他们认为伊朗才是这个地区真正的霸权野心者，

sentences.en: and one that's creating problems in various countries like Yemen, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, and so forth.
sentences.zh: 并且是一个在也门、伊拉克、叙利亚、黎巴嫩等国制造问题的国家。

sentences.en: So what was the response from the Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Donald Trump's host,
sentences.zh: 那么以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡——唐纳德·特朗普的东道主——有什么回应呢？

sentences.en: when Trump basically prodded him to do something that Israel may view as kind of at the request of these Muslim neighbors?
sentences.zh: 当特朗普基本上敦促他做一件以色列可能认为是在这些穆斯林邻国要求下做的事情时？

sentences.en: Well, it's interesting.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很有趣。

sentences.en: I want you to know how much we appreciate the change in American policy on Iran.
sentences.zh: 我想让你们知道我们多么感激美国对伊朗政策的改变。

sentences.en: What you heard from Prime Minister Netanyahu afterwards was a lot of agreement about the part about Iran.
sentences.zh: 你在之后听到的内塔尼亚胡总理的讲话中，有很多关于伊朗部分的赞同。

sentences.en: I believe that together we could roll back Iran's march of aggression and terror in this region, and we can thwart Iran's unbridled ambition to become a nuclear weapons state.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们齐心协力就能击退伊朗在这个地区的侵略和恐怖行径，我们就能挫败伊朗成为核武器国家的无节制野心。

sentences.en: And no words at all about the Palestinian issue.
sentences.zh: 而对巴勒斯坦问题则只字未提。

sentences.en: There's a reason for that, because even if he wanted to himself, he leads a fragile coalition government
sentences.zh: 这其中是有原因的，因为即使他自己愿意，他领导的是一个脆弱的联合政府，

sentences.en: that includes a lot of right-wing parties, federal parties, that are not interested in any kind of deal and that want him to basically tell Trump to go away if he forces them to.
sentences.zh: 其中包含许多右翼政党、联邦政党，他们对任何形式的协议都不感兴趣，如果特朗普强迫他们，他们甚至想让内塔尼亚胡叫特朗普走开。

sentences.en: Peter, has any of the controversy back home in Washington followed the president to Israel?
sentences.zh: 彼得，华盛顿老家的那些争议有没有跟着总统来到以色列？

sentences.en: Last week, the Times reported that Trump told top Russian officials about highly classified information
sentences.zh: 上周，《泰晤士报》报道称，特朗普向俄罗斯高级官员透露了高度机密的信息，

sentences.en: relating to a threat by ISIS that we later learned had been provided to the United States by Israel
sentences.zh: 这些信息涉及ISIS的威胁，我们后来得知是由以色列提供给美国的，

sentences.en: on the condition that we not share it, and nevertheless, the president did share it with these Russian officials.
sentences.zh: 前提是我们不得分享，然而总统还是与这些俄罗斯官员分享了。

sentences.en: Is that hanging over this trip at all?
sentences.zh: 这给这次访问蒙上阴影了吗？

sentences.en: Well, it did come up today, as a matter of fact, when he was meeting with Prime Minister Netanyahu, one of the reporters, Margaret Taleb, asked about this question.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上今天确实被提出来了，当他会见内塔尼亚胡总理时，其中一位记者玛格丽特·塔勒布问了这个问题。

sentences.en: Just so you understand, I never mentioned the word or the name Israel.
sentences.zh: 为了让你们明白，我从未提过以色列这个词或这个名字。

sentences.en: Never mentioned it during that conversation.
sentences.zh: 在那次对话中从未提过。

sentences.en: They were all saying that day.
sentences.zh: 他们那天都在这么说。

sentences.en: So you had to know the story wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以你们肯定是报道错了。

sentences.en: Never mentioned the word Israel.
sentences.zh: 从未提过以色列这个词。

sentences.en: The president said, look, I didn't say the name Israel.
sentences.zh: 总统说，听着，我没有说以色列这个名字。

sentences.en: I didn't use the word Israel.
sentences.zh: 我没有用以色列这个词。

sentences.en: So when you guys say that, it's a false story.
sentences.zh: 所以当你们这么说时，这是一个虚假的报道。

sentences.en: Now, we didn't actually say that.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们实际上并没有这么说。

sentences.en: That's not what the story said.
sentences.zh: 报道不是这个意思。

sentences.en: What the story said was that he gave enough information about this intelligence,
sentences.zh: 报道的意思是，他透露了关于这个情报的足够信息，

sentences.en: about an Islamic State plot, that a keen observer, a smart intelligence agency like the Russians have, could put it together and figure out where the source came from
sentences.zh: 关于一个伊斯兰国的阴谋，以至于一个敏锐的观察家、像俄罗斯人那样精明的情报机构，可以将其拼凑起来并弄清楚消息来源出自何处，

sentences.en: and therefore endanger the Israeli source of information.
sentences.zh: 从而危及以色列的情报来源。

sentences.en: Now, Prime Minister Netanyahu is very intent on this not blowing up this visit.
sentences.zh: 现在，内塔尼亚胡总理非常希望这件事不要搞砸这次访问。

sentences.en: It's very important for him to have this visit go smoothly.
sentences.zh: 对毛他来说，这次访问顺利进行非常重要。

sentences.en: So even though a lot of officials here in Israel, particularly in the intelligence agencies and security agencies, are mad about this breach,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管以色列的许多官员，特别是情报和安全机构的官员，对这次泄密感到愤怒，

sentences.en: he has made a point of not saying anything about it publicly, being as warm as possible, and when he was asked about it, he said,
sentences.zh: 但他特意公开对此闭口不谈，表现得尽可能热情，当被问及此事时，他说：

sentences.en: intelligence sharing is terrific.
sentences.zh: 情报共享非常棒。

sentences.en: It's better than it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 比以往任何时候都要好。

sentences.en: So he's trying very hard to downplay this as a dispute.
sentences.zh: 所以他非常努力地淡化这是一场争端。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 彼得，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We will no doubt check in with you in a couple of days, and I hope you get some sleep.
sentences.zh: 我们毫无疑问会在几天后再与你连线，希望你能睡个好觉。

sentences.en: Okay, take care.
sentences.zh: 好的，保重。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简讯《DealBook》的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的 DealBook 峰会现场采访商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的几位领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde,
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、

sentences.en: Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 齐尔兰·蒙达尼等等。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 NYTimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，你可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并免费获得我们所有新闻报道一个月的访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你绝对不想错过。

sentences.en: Did you just publish?
sentences.zh: 你刚才发布了吗？

sentences.en: It literally just published, yeah.
sentences.zh: 字面意思上刚发布，对。

sentences.en: This is what we were just working on.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们刚刚一直在处理的内容。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Why don't you pause for a minute and give it a quick read?
sentences.zh: 你为什么不暂停一分钟，快速阅读一下？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Matt Rosenberg came into the studio in Washington with the latest on President Trump's former National Security Advisor, Michael Flynn.
sentences.zh: 马特·罗森伯格来到华盛顿的演播室，带来了关于特朗普总统前国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林的最新消息。

sentences.en: So we've got two things.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有两件事。

sentences.en: The first bit of news was that Flynn has now rejected a subpoena from the Senate Intelligence Committee to hand over documents relating to any contacts
sentences.zh: 第一条消息是，弗林现在拒绝了参议院情报委员会交出文件的传票，这些文件关于任何联络

sentences.en: he may have had with the Russians between, like, 2015 and the election.
sentences.zh: 他可能在2015年到大选期间与俄罗斯人有过接触。

sentences.en: So that was, like, the big news of the day.
sentences.zh: 所以这可以说是今天最大的新闻了。

sentences.en: And then late today, the top Democrat on the House Oversight Committee, which, by the way, if you don't understand all these committees, neither do I.
sentences.zh: 然后就在今天晚些时候，众议院监督委员会的顶级民主党人——顺便说一句，如果你搞不懂所有这些委员会，我也不懂。

sentences.en: Half of us don't.
sentences.zh: 我们有一半人都不懂。

sentences.en: But, you know, they exiSt.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，它们确实存在。

sentences.en: So the House Oversight Committee, the top Democrat is this guy named Elijah Cummings.
sentences.zh: 所以众议院监督委员会的顶级民主党人是这个名叫埃利亚·卡明斯的人。

sentences.en: He's been pretty aggressive on the Flynn situation.
sentences.zh: 他在弗林这件事上一直相当激进。

sentences.en: And so he released a letter today indicating that Flynn misled Pentagon investigators about his income from Russian companies in contacts with Russian officials
sentences.zh: 因此他今天发布了一封信，指出弗林在2016年初申请更新其绝密安全许可时，

sentences.en: when he applied for renewal of his top-secret security clearance at the beginning of 2016.
sentences.zh: 曾向五角大楼调查人员隐瞒了他在与俄罗斯公司和俄罗斯官员接触中的收入。

sentences.en: So every five years, if you have a security clearance, you have to get it renewed.
sentences.zh: 所以每五年，如果你拥有安全许可，你就必须更新它。

sentences.en: After you retire, generals and other kind of senior officers are courted, what they call courtesy clearances, where they're allowed to keep their security clearance.
sentences.zh: 在你退休后，将军和其他高级军官会受到奉承，也就是他们所谓的礼节性许可，他们被允许保留安全许可。

sentences.en: And it's really important for them because it opens up incredibly lucrative jobs with, like, government contractors.
sentences.zh: 这对于他们来说非常重要，因为它能带来与政府承包商合作的极其丰厚的工作机会。

sentences.en: And so at the beginning of 2016, Flynn's clearance was up for a renewal.
sentences.zh: 所以在2016年初，弗林的许可即将到期更新。

sentences.en: He'd retired two years earlier as head of the Defense Intelligence Agency.
sentences.zh: 他在两年前作为国防情报局局长退休。

sentences.en: He was forced out of the job by the Obama administration, took his retirement.
sentences.zh: 他被奥巴马政府逼迫离职，办理了退休。

sentences.en: And now, early 2016, he's got to renew the thing.
sentences.zh: 现在，在2016年初，他必须更新这个许可。

sentences.en: He did not tell them that the year before, he'd taken a number of payments from Russian companies, including $45,000, to give a speech in December 2015 in Moscow for RT,
sentences.zh: 他没有告诉他们，就在前一年，他收到了来自俄罗斯公司的多笔款项，其中包括45,000美元，用于2015年12月在莫斯科为RT发表一次演讲，

sentences.en: which is a Kremlin finance news network, and also attend its kind of lavish anniversary dinner at Moscow, where he was photographed sitting at the elbow of Vladimir Putin.
sentences.zh: RT是克里姆林宫资助的新闻网络，他还出席了它在莫斯科举行的那种奢华的周年晚宴，在那里他被拍到坐在弗拉基米尔·普京的肘部旁边。

sentences.en: He just sort of left that out.
sentences.zh: 他只是把这事给漏掉了。

sentences.en: And the reason this is important is because if he is found to have actively misled the investigators who do the security clearances, that's a serious felony.
sentences.zh: 这件事之所以重要，是因为如果他被发现主动误导了负责安全许可的调查人员，那是一项严重的重罪。

sentences.en: It carries up to five years in prison.
sentences.zh: 最高可判处五年监禁。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a big issue.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个大问题。

sentences.en: And this sort of adds to his legal woes.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是雪上加霜，增加了他的法律麻烦。

sentences.en: You know, the separate Justice Department investigation is scrutinizing his work he did later in 2016 when he was already advising Donald Trump,
sentences.zh: 你知道，独立的司法部调查正在仔细审查他在2016年晚些时候的工作，当时他已经在为唐纳德·特朗普担任顾问，

sentences.en: secretly lobbying for a Turkish government on behalf of this third-party company.
sentences.zh: 代表这个第三方公司秘密为土耳其政府游说。

sentences.en: Failing to properly register for that is another potentially serious felony as well.
sentences.zh: 未能为此进行适当的登记也是另一项潜在的严重重罪。

sentences.en: Matt, how does all of this relate to what we already knew about Michael Flynn's relationship with Russia that got him fired from the Trump administration in the first place?
sentences.zh: 马特，所有这一切与我们已经知道的迈克尔·弗林与俄罗斯的关系有什么关系？正是这种关系导致他在一开始被特朗普政府解雇？

sentences.en: I mean, it kind of adds to the noise about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这在某种程度上增加了这方面的噪音。

sentences.en: I think we already pretty well deeply knew he'd had pretty extensive contacts with Russians.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们其实已经相当清楚地知道他与俄罗斯人有过相当广泛的接触。

sentences.en: He was fired for misleading people within the Trump administration about conversations he'd had with the Russian ambassador at the end of December.
sentences.zh: 他因在12月底与俄罗斯大使进行的谈话误导特朗普政府内部的人而被解雇。

sentences.en: So on December 29th, the Obama administration imposed sanctions on Russia over the election interference and took a bunch of other measures.
sentences.zh: 所以在12月29日，奥巴马政府因俄罗斯干预大选对其实施了制裁，并采取了一系列其他措施。

sentences.en: The way we understand it, we've been told, is Mike Flynn throughout that day and into the next day had multiple conversations with the Russian ambassador, Sergei Kislyak,
sentences.zh: 我们所理解的，我们被告知的是，迈克尔·弗林在整整那天以及第二天与俄罗斯大使谢尔盖·基斯利亚克进行了多次谈话，

sentences.en: where he appeared to kind of talk the Russians off the ledge.
sentences.zh: 在这些谈话中，他似乎在劝说俄罗斯人不要冲动。

sentences.en: They don't worry.
sentences.zh: 他们不用担心。

sentences.en: It's going to be fine.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好的。

sentences.en: We'll be in power soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快就会掌权。

sentences.en: We're going to work this out.
sentences.zh: 我们会解决这个问题的。

sentences.en: And now, who knew what and when they knew it within the Trump administration about those calls is still very much a subject of speculation.
sentences.zh: 现在，在特朗普政府内部，谁在什么时候知道这些通话仍然是一个充满猜测的话题。

sentences.en: But the Trump administration says that he did not tell Pence and others.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普政府坚称他没有告诉彭斯和其他人。

sentences.en: And Pence at one point went out and said he never had those conversations.
sentences.zh: 彭斯一度曾公开表示他从未有过那些谈话。

sentences.en: And so when it became public that he did, he was fired basically for misleading Pence was the reason given.
sentences.zh: 因此，当他确实有过这些谈话的消息公开时，他基本上因为误导了彭斯而被解雇，这就是给出的原因。

sentences.en: So this feels like the third or the fourth revelation about Flynn in just the last couple of weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以这感觉就像是过去几周内关于弗林的第三或第四次爆料。

sentences.en: There was something a week or so ago about President Obama warning Donald Trump against hiring Flynn, which leaked out.
sentences.zh: 大约一周前左右，曾有关于奥巴马总统警告唐纳德·特朗普不要雇用弗林的消息泄露出来。

sentences.en: So is this starting to look like, essentially, why in the world would the Trump administration have ever hired Michael Flynn?
sentences.zh: 那么这是否开始看起来像是一个问题：究竟为什么特朗普政府会雇用迈克尔·弗林？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So I'm going to insert myself personally into the story here for a second.
sentences.zh: 所以我要在这里插播一下我个人的经历。

sentences.en: I've known Flynn since 2009 when I was covering Afghanistan and he was the intelligence chief there.
sentences.zh: 我从2009年起就认识弗林了，当时我在报道阿富汗，他是那里的情报主管。

sentences.en: And I got to know him pretty well.
sentences.zh: 我对他相当了解。

sentences.en: You know, I think up until October or November this year, he would have told people we were friendly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想直到今年10月或11月，他还会告诉别人我们是朋友。

sentences.en: And I think those of us who knew him then, and I was talking to somebody recently, were amazed that he was national security advisor.
sentences.zh: 我想我们这些当时认识他的人，我最近还在跟人聊天，都对他是国家安全顾问感到惊讶。

sentences.en: We would never have guessed he would have ever had that job.
sentences.zh: 我们怎么也猜不到他会得到这份工作。

sentences.en: And we're even more amazed that he's now at the center of a scandal that is threatening an entire presidential administration.
sentences.zh: 而更让我们惊讶的是，他现在竟然成为了一个威胁到整个总统行政机构的丑闻的中心。

sentences.en: But the reasons we would have thought he would have never been a national security advisor are all the reasons why we're not necessarily surprised he's at the center of this scandal.
sentences.zh: 但我们认为他绝不应该成为国家安全顾问的种种原因，正是我们对他身处这个丑闻中心并不感到完全意外的原因。

sentences.en: Look, he was this roguish, maverick-type character in the military who would break rules and give intelligence to all kinds of people that he wasn't supposed to.
sentences.zh: 听着，他是军队中那种放荡不羁、特立独行的角色，会打破规则，把情报透露给各种他不该透露的人。

sentences.en: And he always saw it as, I'm making the system better.
sentences.zh: 他总是把这看作是：我在让这个体制变得更好。

sentences.en: So he just went his own way.
sentences.zh: 所以他只是我行我素。

sentences.en: He always went his own way.
sentences.zh: 他一直都我行我素。

sentences.en: And so the fact that he went his own way on this stuff is not entirely surprising, but it is one of those reasons, like, why was he hired?
sentences.zh: 因此，他在这些事情上我行我素并不是完全出人意料，但这正是那些让人觉得“他当初为什么会被雇用”的原因之一。

sentences.en: Why wasn't their background check more thorough?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们的背景调查不够彻底？

sentences.en: And I think it speaks to how the Trump administration viewed people who were loyal to the president.
sentences.zh: 我认为这反映了特朗普政府是如何看待那些对总统忠诚的人的。

sentences.en: Flynn was probably the only brand-name general that really stood up for Trump early and stayed with him for the whole campaign.
sentences.zh: 弗林可能是唯一一个在早期真正支持特朗普并在整个竞选期间一直留在他身边的大牌将军。

sentences.en: Lock her up.
sentences.zh: 把她关起来。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yes, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Lock her up.
sentences.zh: 把她关起来。

sentences.en: I mean, Flynn was out there at the convention, leading chance of lock her up, lock her up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，弗林当时在大会上，带头高喊“把她关起来，把她关起来”。

sentences.en: The idea that a former general was leading chance about a former U.S.
sentences.zh: 一个前将军竟然带头高喊关于一个前美国参议员和国务卿的口号，

sentences.en: senator and secretary of state just horrified his peers in the military.
sentences.zh: 这简直让他在军队里的同僚们感到震惊。

sentences.en: Damn right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: You're exactly right.
sentences.zh: 你完全说对了。

sentences.en: There's nothing wrong with that.
sentences.zh: 那没有什么不对的。

sentences.en: When he retired, he was considered one of the probably best military intelligence officers of his generation.
sentences.zh: 当他退休时，他被认为是其那一代人中最优秀的军事情报军官之一。

sentences.en: And I think even through his firing, I know a lot of former military people who would say, you know, okay, we don't necessarily agree with him.
sentences.zh: 我想即使在他被解雇之后，我也认识很多前军方人员，他们会说，好吧，我们不一定同意他的看法。

sentences.en: And it's good he's gone, but let's be respectful.
sentences.zh: 而且他走了是好事，但我们要保持尊重。

sentences.en: He served and he did his duty honorably.
sentences.zh: 他曾服役并光荣地履行了职责。

sentences.en: But I've also, I've seen the Facebook posts from some of these guys.
sentences.zh: 但我也看过其中一些人的Facebook帖子。

sentences.en: When all the avalanche of stuff that's been coming out since March started coming out, their view of him was like, forget it.
sentences.zh: 当3月份以来开始涌现出大量事件时，他们的看法是：算了吧。

sentences.en: Like, we're done.
sentences.zh: 就像，我们受够了。

sentences.en: Say whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 随便你想说什么都行。

sentences.en: And you know why?
sentences.zh: 你知道为什么吗？

sentences.en: You know why we're saying that?
sentences.zh: 你知道我们为什么这么说吗？

sentences.en: We're saying that because if I, a guy who knows this business, if I did a tenth, a tenth of what she did, I would be in jail today.
sentences.zh: 我们这么说是因为如果我，一个懂这行的人，哪怕做了她所做的事情的十分之一，我今天就已经身陷囹圄了。

sentences.en: So, Matt, as someone who knew this man very well before now, help us understand exactly what's going on now that he's become a central figure in this investigation.
sentences.zh: 所以，马特，作为一个在此之前非常了解这个人的人，请帮我们理解一下，现在他成为了这项调查的中心人物，到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: How do you make sense of his role in this investigation as it started to heat up?
sentences.zh: 随着调查开始升温，你如何看待他在这次调查中的角色？

sentences.en: Well, I want to state up front that he hasn't spoken to me since late October.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我想先说明的是，他从10月下旬开始就再也没有和我说过话了。

sentences.en: And he's referred to me as an adversary to mutual friends.
sentences.zh: 而且他在共同的朋友面前称我为对手。

sentences.en: So, you know, in a lot of ways, I find this kind of sad.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，在很多方面，我发现这有点令人难过。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道，

sentences.en: this is a guy who got out probably a bit too ahead of himself and maybe into something that he wasn't quite ready for and was with a group of people in the Trump administration who seemed to have not given a lot of thought to how you lay out your life if you're going to serve in public office.
sentences.zh: 这个人可能有点得意忘形，也许卷入了一些他并没有完全准备好的事情中，并且和特朗普政府的一群人在一起，这些人似乎并没有花太多心思去考虑如果你要在公职服务，你应该如何规划自己的人生。

sentences.en: You know, in the two years after he left the Defense Intelligence Agency, he started this Flynn Intelligence Group, this private business,
sentences.zh: 你知道，在他离开国防情报局后的两年里，他创办了弗林情报集团，这是一项私人业务，

sentences.en: and they did a lot of work that wasn't going to look good.
sentences.zh: 他们做了很多看起来不太好的工作。

sentences.en: You're doing business with RT, sitting next to Vladimir Putin, lobbying for Turkey without disclosing it.
sentences.zh: 你与RT做生意，坐在普京旁边，在没有披露的情况下为土耳其游说。

sentences.en: These things all look terrible.
sentences.zh: 这些事情看起来都糟糕透了。

sentences.en: And so it's hard when you leave government life or leave the military to go out and do what you want and then come back into it if you haven't carefully chosen what you want to do.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你离开政府生活或离开军队去走你想走的路，如果你没有仔细选择你想做的事，然后再想回来，那就很难了。

sentences.en: And if you don't honestly disclose what you've done.
sentences.zh: 而且如果你没有诚实地披露你所做过的事。

sentences.en: So let's come back to the Senate subpoena.
sentences.zh: 所以我们回到参议院的传票上来。

sentences.en: Why do you think that Michael Flynn is now refusing this subpoena?
sentences.zh: 你认为为什么迈克尔·弗林现在拒绝接受这份传票？

sentences.en: So we've got the letter that Flynn sent to the committee and it said that the congressional investigations, plus the appointment of the special counsel last week, had given Flynn,
sentences.zh: 所以我们收到了弗林发给委员会的信，信中说国会的调查，加上上周特别检察官的任命，给了弗林，

sentences.en: quote, a reasonable cause to apprehend danger, unquote, should he comply with the subpoena.
sentences.zh: 引述，“合理的理由去预见危险”，引述结束，如果他遵守传票的话。

sentences.en: And then it goes on to say he's the target on a nearly daily basis of outrageous allegations,
sentences.zh: 接着信中说，他几乎每天都是无理指控的目标，

sentences.en: often attributed to anonymous sources in Congress or elsewhere in the United States government, which, however fanciful on their face and unsubstantiated by evidence,
sentences.zh: 这些指控通常归咎于国会或美国政府其他地方的匿名消息来源，然而这些指控表面上极其荒诞且没有证据支持，

sentences.en: feed the escalating public frenzy against him.
sentences.zh: 却助长了针对他的不断升级的公众狂热。

sentences.en: So he feels he's not going to get a fair shake.
sentences.zh: 所以他觉得他不会得到公正的对待。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Matt, what happens when you refuse a subpoena?
sentences.zh: 马特，当你拒绝传票时会发生什么？

sentences.en: And by the way, if you wanted to do me a favor and tell me what a subpoena is, then that would be helpful to you.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果你能帮个忙，告诉我什么是传票，那对你会有帮助的。

sentences.en: A subpoena is simply an order by court, or in this case, Congress, that orders you to hand over materials they've asked for or to come and testify.
sentences.zh: 传票只是一项法院（或者在本案中是国会）的命令，命令你交出他们要求的材料或者出庭作证。

sentences.en: If you refuse to comply, you can be held in contempt of Congress.
sentences.zh: 如果你拒绝遵守，你可能会被判定藐视国会。

sentences.en: It's unclear if Congress is going to do that, what steps they'll take.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚国会是否会这样做，他们会采取什么步骤。

sentences.en: You know, contempt of Congress is a political decision as much as it is a legal decision.
sentences.zh: 你知道，藐视国会既是一个政治决定，也是一个法律决定。

sentences.en: And so right now, we're not quite sure how Congress is going to play this.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，我们不太确定国会将如何应对。

sentences.en: Why might Flynn participate in one of these many investigations but refuse to participate in another?
sentences.zh: 为什么弗林可能会参与其中许多调查，但拒绝参与另一项？

sentences.en: Well, the thing is, is the FBI and Justice Department investigation could put him in jail.
sentences.zh: 嗯，关键是，FBI和司法部的调查可能会把他送进监狱。

sentences.en: Congress can't.
sentences.zh: 国会不能。

sentences.en: So if there's anyone he's going to try and cooperate with, it's going to be the federal investigators.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有谁是他愿意合作的，那将是联邦调查人员。

sentences.en: It's certainly been suggested that he wants to cut a deal.
sentences.zh: 确实有人提出他想达成一项交易。

sentences.en: I mean, he offered to testify to the Senate exchange for immunity.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他曾主动提出向参议院作证以换取豁免权。

sentences.en: We have no reason to believe he had not made the same offer to the FBI.
sentences.zh: 我们没有理由相信他没有向FBI提出过同样的提议。

sentences.en: We're told they don't want to do that because he's seen as a major target, one of their main targets, the investigators.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知他们不想这样做，因为他被视为一个重大目标，调查人员的主要目标之一。

sentences.en: So you don't want to, like, let the top guy off and give him immunity and he can implicate people beneath him.
sentences.zh: 所以你不会想，比如，放过大人物，给他豁免权，而他可以牵连他下面的人。

sentences.en: At least that's their thinking.
sentences.zh: 至少他们的想法是这样的。

sentences.en: You know, we don't know anything about his innocence or guilt here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们对他的清白或有罪一无所知。

sentences.en: But I think that ultimately, if you're deciding, well, there are three different investigations, the one you're going to cooperate with is the one that could put you in prison.
sentences.zh: 但我认为归根结底，如果你在做决定，好吧，有三个不同的调查，你要合作的那个将是那个可能把你送进监狱的调查。

sentences.en: Why do you describe Flynn as the top guy?
sentences.zh: 你为什么把弗林描述为最重要的人物？

sentences.en: Why does everyone want to hear from him?
sentences.zh: 为什么每个人都想听他怎么说？

sentences.en: So he was somebody who was with Trump through the whole campaign.
sentences.zh: 因为他是整个竞选期间一直陪在特朗普身边的人。

sentences.en: He had numerous contacts with Russian officials.
sentences.zh: 他与俄罗斯官员有过多次接触。

sentences.en: He also appears to have potentially committed other serious felonies.
sentences.zh: 他似乎还可能犯下了其他严重的重罪。

sentences.en: You know, for the Justice Department, you think, OK, if he knows anything, we can flip him with this because he's looking at real jail time here.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对司法部来说，你会想，好吧，如果他知道什么，我们可以用这个来策反他，因为他在这里面临着真正的牢狱之灾。

sentences.en: But, you know, the Justice Department hasn't given him immunity yet.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，司法部还没有给他豁免权。

sentences.en: So they may just think we can charge him with all this other stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以他们可能只是认为我们可以用所有这些其他事情起诉他。

sentences.en: Just a quick note.
sentences.zh: 顺便简单提一句。

sentences.en: When you want immunity, the FBI does something they call queen for a day where they bring you in and you tell them everything you know.
sentences.zh: 当你想要豁免权时，FBI会做一个他们称之为“一日女王”的流程，他们把你带进去，你把你知道的一切都告诉他们。

sentences.en: And it's all off the record.
sentences.zh: 而且这都是非正式的。

sentences.en: It can't be used against you later.
sentences.zh: 以后不能用来对付你。

sentences.en: And that gives them a sense of, OK, is this somebody who wants to give immunity or not to?
sentences.zh: 这让他们对以下情况有个底，好吧，这是否是一个想要给予豁免权的人？

sentences.en: Which I just love the name queen for a day.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢“一日女王”这个名字了。

sentences.en: Yeah, why not king?
sentences.zh: 对啊，为什么不是国王？

sentences.en: I guess the king is the guy who's going to put you in jail.
sentences.zh: 我猜国王就是那个要把你关进监狱的人。

sentences.en: Matt, this has been quite a surprise and really fascinating.
sentences.zh: 马特，这真是太令人意外也太吸引人了。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Finally, around 10.30 p.m.
sentences.zh: 最后，在周一晚上10点30分左右，

sentences.en: on Monday night, a massive explosion went off inside the Manchester Arena, a concert venue in northwest England, where a performance by Ariana Grande was just ending.
sentences.zh: 曼彻斯特竞技场内部发生了一起大规模爆炸，这是一个位于英格兰西北部的音乐会场馆，当时爱莉安娜·格兰德的演出正接近尾声。

sentences.en: The arena had been filled with young teenagers there to see the 23-year-old performer.
sentences.zh: 竞技场里挤满了来看这位23岁歌手演出的年轻青少年。

sentences.en: This has been the most horrific incident we have ever faced here in Greater Manchester, and one that we all hoped we would never see.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在大曼彻斯特地区面临的最可怕的事件，也是我们所有人都希望永远不会看到的事件。

sentences.en: Families and many young people were out to enjoy a concert at the Manchester Arena and have very sadly lost their lives.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭和年轻人前往曼彻斯特竞技场欣赏音乐会，却不幸失去了生命。

sentences.en: Our thoughts are with those 22 victims that we now know have died, the 59 people who have been injured, and their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我们的心与我们现在所知的已经遇难的22名受害者、59名受伤人员以及他们的亲人同在。

sentences.en: Greater Manchester's Chief Constable Ian Hawkins spoke in the early hours on Tuesday morning.
sentences.zh: 大曼彻斯特郡警察局长伊恩·霍金斯于周二凌晨发表了讲话。

sentences.en: We have been treating this as a terrorist incident, and we believe at this stage, the attack last night was conducted by one man.
sentences.zh: 我们一直将此作为恐怖主义事件处理，并且我们目前认为，昨晚的袭击是由一人实施的。

sentences.en: The priority is to establish whether he was acting alone or as part of a network.
sentences.zh: 当务之急是确定他是单独作案还是某个网络的一部分。

sentences.en: The attacker, I can confirm, died at the arena.
sentences.zh: 我可以证实，袭击者已在体育馆内死亡。

sentences.en: We believe the attacker was carrying an improvised explosive device, which he detonated, causing this atrocity.
sentences.zh: 我们认为袭击者携带了一枚简易爆炸装置并将其引爆，造成了这起惨绝人寰的暴行。

sentences.en: It is now beyond doubt that the people of Manchester and of this country have fallen victim to a callous terrorist attack.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，曼彻斯特乃至全国的人民已经沦为残忍恐怖袭击的受害者。

sentences.en: Prime Minister Theresa May spoke on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 首相特雷莎·梅于周二发表了讲话。

sentences.en: An attack that targeted some of the youngest people in our society with cold calculation.
sentences.zh: 这是一场经过冷血密谋、将目标对准我们社会中最年轻群体的袭击。

sentences.en: This was among the worst terrorist incidents we have ever experienced in the United Kingdom.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在英国经历过的最严重的恐怖主义事件之一。

sentences.en: And although it is not the first time Manchester has suffered in this way, it is the worst attack the city has experienced, and the worst ever to hit the north of England.
sentences.zh: 尽管这并非曼彻斯特第一次遭受此类苦难，但这是该市经历过的最严重袭击，也是有史以来打击英格兰北部最严重的袭击。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》节目到此结束。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器在运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了许多自称为改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党就陷入了一场痛苦、混乱且有时令人兴奋的内斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》节目中，由我，萨拉·科尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
